official_findings.finding: Google age_group is single-valued at the submitted offer. Different age variants need their own accurate value and the same item_group_id. A mixed family product cannot be repaired by assigning all offers adult or all offers kids.

Google defines newborn0–3months, infant3–12months, toddler1–5years, kids5–13years and adult typically13+. Child labels alone do not justify kids for every child variant; the age5 boundary overlaps in the published ranges and needs the product's intended age classification.

The app's official instructions name its product bulk editor and a general variant-editing route, but do not document the exact age_group field's per-variant override, storage namespace/key, or product-versus-variant precedence. Those consumption details remain unverified.

Shopify says the Google & YouTube channel does not use legacy Google Shopping CSV unstructured metafields, including Age Group. This prevents assuming those CSV columns are a working repair path. The page does not explicitly identify the mm-google-shopping namespace or establish the current consumption of this store's existing variant keys.
